intent: Compile ordered multi-ticket plans so a campaign of tickets can declare and validate dependencies.

requirements.REQ-DAG-A: A plan file lists ticket identifiers with explicit depends_on references and the compiler rejects unknown or cyclic references.
requirements.REQ-DAG-B: Compilation of a dependent ticket records which planned tickets already completed.

unknowns: Plan file format and storage location
Whether execution ordering is enforced by the compiler or the launchers
